role: The non-living entity pool: one ie_ent record shared by items, XP orbs, arrows, throwables, potions, fireballs, eyes of ender and primed TNT, the per-chunk y-section entity lists, the removal log, and the ie_world pool with its owner callbacks; declares the spawn, adopt, tick, unload and query functions.

structs.name: ie_ent
structs.java: Entity plus EntityItem, EntityXPOrb, EntityArrow, EntityThrowable, EntityPotion, EntityFireball, EntityEnderEye and EntityTNTPrimed fields in one tagged record

structs.name: ie_world
structs.java: the non-living half of World.loadedEntityList with World.rand and the owner hooks

gpu: line 43: ie_ent.iew back pointer to the owning pool
lines 66-67 and 101: owner_name and thrower string pointers, stack_count_link int pointer
shooting_entity and shooter are lrefs (living.h); stack_count_link a stack_link; the world's list holds pool slots (lane/gpuarena, L3)
line 122: ie_chunk holds 16 x 2048 ie_ent pointers per chunk (about 256 KB each)
ie_world.slot is a fixed array of IE_MAX_ENTITIES (8192) pool slots; ie_list_push stops the program with a message past it
line 162: ie_world.chunks is a heap array grown by realloc
lines 166-202: eleven owner callbacks (function pointers) the tick calls into
line 174 and 189: query_living and blast_entities callbacks return entities in the owner's container order
notes: The ie_ent field list above is abridged to the main groups (tile_y, tile_z, in_data, accel_y, accel_z, eye_target_y, eye_target_z, prev_*, last_tick_*, rotation and flag fields are also present). The kind enum covers IE_ITEM to IE_TNT; projectile behaviour lives in projectile.c. The Entity and EntityItem field names are mapped from comments; the owner and thrower fields are EntityItem.field_145801_f/field_145802_g by position, not confirmed by a comment.
